class.name: JarTransformSdf
class.brief_description: Positions, rotates and scales a child SDF.
class.description: Applies a [Transform3D] to any child SDF: the query point is mapped into the child's local space, the child is evaluated there, and the resulting distance is rescaled by the transform's scale. Together with [JarOperationSdf] this forms a complete CSG toolkit — for example, a rotated [JarCylinderSdf] subtracted from terrain carves a slanted tunnel. [b]Note:[/b] non-uniform scale is approximated using the average of the three scale factors, which is a conservative bound commonly used with SDFs.

members.member: The child SDF to transform. If unset, empty space is returned.
The transform applied to the child SDF (its local-to-world transform).
